title: Missouri v. McNeely (2013)
key_points: Holding: The natural dissipation of alcohol does not automatically create an exigency for a warrantless blood draw; exigency is judged case by case.
officer_notes: Scenario: In a routine DWI arrest with a judge available, you want blood drawn without a warrant.
Takeaway: Seek a warrant for blood unless specific facts create a real emergency.
